notes.title: An Update from Aggro Crab
notes.content:
Hey crabs it's time for a [b]BIG[/b] studio update. We made a video version on YouTube which you can watch [url=https://youtu.be/L3SMrIuGheY]HERE[/url], but if you prefer to read - this is for you. 

In 2024 we released our largest game yet. Another Crab’s Treasure was Aggro Crab’s big project that we had worked on for 3+ years! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/4f1f8c5a17a86d4f0b57500739eb909c39beb870.png[/img]

We then released Year of the Crab. The team has enjoyed seeing your reactions to a certain [i]mean snail[/i] and all the additional new features, including NG+. This content update was a way for us to add features that tied up any loose ends on the project. We've released a series of patches to address any bugs or stability troubles following the content release - so thanks for reporting in our Discord to help us navigate these issues! 

It'll likely be the last patch for Another Crab's Treasure unless something like, explodes. This means it’s time for us to move on to new things. So let’s talk about what we did next!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/6a3a0cac542566e932294f86d641de1cd79a03ba.gif[/img]

Later in 2024, we announced that we'd begun development on our NEXT project… which we have been calling [b]GAME 3[/b]. We were funded for the project already and had begun prototyping almost immediately after Another Crab’s Treasure was released. 

We started off [i]excited[/i] for a new project, with big ideas and passion! Unfortunately, after a few months… We lost funding. Our funding partner just had different visions to what we saw in Game 3. It happens! We then tried to look for a new funding partner but struggled to find one that we could come to an agreement with. After months of pitching, we decided to shelve game 3 indefinitely.

That game was-

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/07e05e4b65af5b1e3d363fe1838bc10140523c2b.png[/img]

Going Under 2. The sequel to our first game before Another Crab's Treasure. 

This choice sucked! But losing funding wasn’t the only reason we decided to do this. Turns out, making a game for 3+ years is hard…and like, makes everyone really tired. Our team was burnt out, and jumping from one large project to another large project was a lot for us to handle. Losing funding really made us evaluate how everyone was feeling underneath it all. The built up exhaustion and burnout was causing us to really resent working on Going Under 2.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/518076dd2d28fc257db467c82effbef479f9f372.png[/img]

Although the screenshots make it look pretty great, we were struggling endlessly to land on a prototype we were actually proud of. Turns out it’s a lot harder to make fun games if we aren’t having any fun doing it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/ab3f49acc346ad174771c31806057c35b44d7f98.png[/img]

After assessing all of this, we came to the conclusion that for the future of Aggro Crab's sustainability as a studio and the people themselves, we NEED to change what we’re doing. So we shook things up. Instead of working on a large project again, we started small. No big ideas, just something silly to bring back the spark a few of us were missing. How about a game jam? 

We locked in for a month and made a game! Actually… we made TWO GAMES!!!!!!! Some of us collaborated with our friends over at Landfall to make PEAK. You might have seen this on the [url=https://youtu.be/2MJ06L3yraI?si=ZKLxR30i0m31d15u&t=710]Landfall day livestream[/url] which you can watch here. SO PEAK COMING SOON. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/b15c4a71b0e72fd633afb29f94f3e8cd201e316b.png[/img]
THEN the rest of the crew locked in to create the second game, which we’ve been calling Crash Out Crew. We’re calling these small projects An Aggro Crab Side Hustle. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/4c9f09ad584b8895ea3fdcf97e25699f67ff870b.png[/img]
Both of these games are quite different to our previous projects, but the team’s passion and sense of humor really shows through, and you can tell we had a lot of fun making them!

In the end, shelving Going Under 2 was hard, and we were super bummed to see it go. But the bright side is, in return, we got two smaller scoped projects that gave us the chance to self fund ourselves. It’s pretty hype that we can even do that as an indie studio, especially in the current climate of the games industry with layoffs and the works. Not only did we get two new games out of it- we got our spark back. We’re actually excited and proud to release these games for you to see. You can expect more on both of these games soon, even sooner than you realize. 

But ofc we didn't stop there...

Once those are done, we also have a third, larger project that we plan to start this year. THAT'S RIGHT. OUR NEW GAME 3! You can’t stop us. We’re actually excited to get back into a large project now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/bf537bac6ae253ed719ec5e8dcf0c68bffb9bb49.jpg[/img]

So yeah. It’s been a hectic 2025 for us already. But it’s looking good! Keep an eye out for future updates, and thank you again for all the support on Another Crab’s Treasure and our scrappy indie studio. 

- Paige (Community Manager)

notes.title: YEAR OF THE CRAB: THE FREE CONTENT UPDATE IS OUT NOW
notes.content:
It's finally Time for Crab once again! Just four days short of Another Crab's Treasure's one year anniversary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/0bcac61ee28bad6aaeefdd9d8e16c993145ca437.png[/img]

We worked really hard on this update. As you can see, there's a lot. And we're pretty proud of how much we were able to throw in. Thank you for following us on our crab journey. So dive in, get your shell handed to you, thank us, then try again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/0dc24b87ae3f3b51f7718a6b3f768c2fe9ad1f99.png[/img]

In case you missed our previous post, here's a look at what's in the update...

As a reminder, this is not a DLC, it's a [b]FREE[/b] yes [b]FREE content update[/b]. It's not a small one either, we packed this baby with a bunch of new stuff:

[h2]NEW GAME PLUS[/h2]
The most highly requested feature from the community ever since we launched was [b]New Game Plus[/b], and the response to the game has been so overwhelming that we eventually had to do it. I'm happy to say that we [b]cooked[/b] on this.

[b]IMPORTANT: If you have already completed the game prior to the update, you will need to refight the final boss (SPOILERS: [spoiler]Firth[/spoiler]) to activate New Game Plus. You can use the gun if you want, I won't snitch. Think of it as a warm up ;)[/b]

We didn't just lazily scale up enemy stats and call it a day, we've added new moves to bosses, some new items, and oh yeah, remixed almost every enemy encounter in the game. You'll even be able to upgrade your fork and stowaway weight even higher. Have you ever wanted FOUR stowaway slots? NG+ has FOUR stowaway slots. PLUS we've also added new exclusive stowaways for NG+, the Sigils.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/a109bab5cd958b0417b34eff618919f09a794342.png[/img]
[i]oOooOooOoohmysteriouswhatdotheydooooo[/i]

OUTSIDE of New Game Plus...

[h2]REFIGHT BOSSES[/h2]
You'll now have the chance to go back to your favorite boss fights and get your shell handed to you through [b]COMBAT MEMORIES[/b]. Maybe you just wanna listen to Polluted Platoon Pathfinder again, I won't judge. Re-fight any defeated boss in your playthrough from any Moon Snail Shell. Speaking of bosses...

[h2]BOSS RUSH MODE[/h2]
Topoda now offers [b]Boss Rush[/b] challenges - with a variety of themed sequential fights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/9d5e6238244821acf41a4becd834a1c9f47af296.png[/img]
Your reward for beating one of these trials is...

[h2]NEW COSTUMES[/h2]
OK I GUESS I can't just move on from this without leaking one of the new costumes. Here's a look at Pretty Princess Kril:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/496559c613acf074dd294efd5767d7a66aea8f2c.png[/img]

[h2]MUSEUM BESTIARY[/h2]
The Museum is finally open again for business, and inside is a constantly updated display of all enemies you encounter and defeat in your journey. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/9dd4890291612f80ae17d5f63a2233a930bdecf4.png[/img]

[h2]CHAPTER SELECT [/h2]
Wanna dive back in to a specific point in the story? Now you can with [b]Chapters[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/aa86b44f3f555b1aba944059b84ca9dc055dd80f.png[/img]
[i]Chapter Select can be enabled from the Settings menu.[/i]

[h2]AND ONE NEW BOSS FIGHT. [/h2]
I'm not snitchin' ok. I won't budge, but trust me it's a well deserved fight. This boss totally deserves it. 

[h2]COMMUNITY UPDATES:[/h2]
Due to popular demand, we've also added new achievements AND community trading cards! Here's a sneak peek at one of them: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/d812cea43afabdb153f4ee0aa1541f5d5d7975b3.jpg[/img]
AND if you're in the speedrunning community, keep an eye out for some speedy snails around the world...  

As usual, if you run into any bugs, you can let us know through our Discord! We try to check Steam forums as much as possible too. 

Hope you all enjoy, and thank you SO SO much for all the support on this game! We’re excited to show you what’s next as soon as it’s ready! It won’t be long now…

Codspeed,
Paige (Community Manager)

notes.title: WDC WORLD OCEAN DAY CHARITY SALE
notes.content:
HELLO WHALE AND DOLPHIN ENJOYERS

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/85ea3b02135e694e0d0887412e2f3c9b19d24838.png[/img]

So we've talked a big game on why [i]Polluting the Ocean = Bad[/i], and now its time for us to put our money where our mouth is. We are excited to announce that we are doing a charity sale with WDC (Whale and Dolphin Conservation) for World Ocean Day!

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 15th June, 10am PDT 2024, and you can save a fin-tastic 15% off ANOTHER CRAB'S TREASURE.

[b]20% of our net revenue during this sale will be donated to WDC[/b] to support their conservation work... AND our funding partner Kowloon is going to match our donation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/fc8cdb82fa63e1298c16630eb0c23c2713f781c0.png[/img]

It's important we share details on the efforts we support, so here's some more details on what WDC gets up to: 

[h3]Who is WDC?[/h3]
WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.
Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic creatures.

Entanglement in fishing gear, or ‘bycatch’ as it’s known, is the biggest threat whales and dolphins face. Many hundreds of thousands die in nets or get tangled up in fishing gear every year. As air-breathing mammals like us, when they get trapped in a net, panic can take over and they can sustain terrible injuries before either escaping, or suffocating. It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/fa36f109a4e85d3ccd3b4934e075867711f4ab2a.jpg[/img]

[h3]What WDC has been doing so far [/h3]
WDC have been working across the globe to protect whales, dolphins and porpoises from dying in fishing gear: 

They’re collaborating with creel fishers in Scotland to trial new types of fishing gear to reduce entanglements of humpback and minke whales. 

They’re working with colleagues and partner organizations in the Central Baltic Sea to develop a recovery plan for a critically endangered group of Baltic harbor porpoises. 

On the west coast of the United States, critically endangered North Atlantic right whales are facing extinction. Entanglement is a massive threat to their survival, and WDC have been working with fishers to trial alternative gear types. 

In Hong Kong WDC have been supporting local community efforts and working with fishers to save the remaining 200 Indo-Pacific finless porpoises from extinction due to bycatch.   

These projects are saving lives, and they are powered by inspiring people working together for the ocean. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/fa9e1ae66aafb6e01562ba9eed6fb49051c76660.jpg[/img]

[h3]How your support will help this year[/h3]
By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue these vital conservation projects across the globe, as well as enable WDC’s team to embark on new efforts to bring further protections for whales and dolphins, like the Sri Lankan gillnet fisheries project: 

Sri Lanka is home to many species of whales, dolphins and porpoises as well as a myriad of other sensitive marine species like sea turtles that are vulnerable to entanglement in gillnets – these are nets that hang in the water like a wall. With funding, WDC hopes to collaborate with Sri Lankan artisanal tuna fisheries that use gillnets to trial new gear types and reduce the impact their fishing has on marine life, while still enabling them to earn their living. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/9644f6c68ef0ccda08350dfcd9ed9c2be7b8e536.png[/img]

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused. 

If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: https://whales.org/ 

Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does here: https://games.whales.org/ 

And you can find many other amazing games in the sale here: https://bit.ly/WODSteamSale24 

Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC!

notes.title: ONE WEEK POST-LAUNCH: What's Next
notes.content:
HI CRAB FANS 

It's been one week since we launched Another Crab's Treasure, and this game has already succeeded beyond our wildest dreams. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/f56415ab75225a541e61d316e6a52ac93944c8e2.gif[/img]

We've hit over 150,000 sales across all platforms, and the critical response has been fantastic. We've seen people laugh, cry, throw their controllers - absolutely everything we dreamed of when creating this game. We've seen reviewers and streamers who place us among the likes of massive genre entries like Lies of P, or even Sekiro - which is unbelievable praise for a team of our size. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for making this launch a true treasure. <3

Of course, we also know things are far from perfect. Having WAY more players than we expected in week 1 has exposed a LOT of bugs, some of the rare ones being deeply serious and progress-ruining. [b][i]Trust us when we say, we see you[/i][/b], and there is no worse feeling as a game dev than watching someone who clearly wants to love the game have their experience ruined by technical issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/559ffc51204784811e734f062aedfb0d7626718c.gif[/img]

At the same time - we're sleepy and tired. Our core team of 11 people busted their ASS to get this game out the door on time at all, as functional as it was. And we've been straining ourselves even harder post-launch pushing near-daily patches to Steam and trying to get those fixes to console as fast as we can to resolve the most serious bugs. We've realized that our tiredness is causing us to make mistakes, and it's clear we need to slow down slightly for all of our health, as well as the long-term health of the game! It's a win-win for both us and the community if we get some rest.

[b]This doesn't mean we're stopping[/b] - We'll be continuing to patch Steam and assemble those fixes for consoles and PC Game Pass regularly. But we're going to begin releasing those Steam patches at a slower rate from now on (no longer will you have random daily patches lol), to give ourselves some time to rest and to allow the new code to be properly tested before it goes live (eg. the bug we pushed that would  lunge kril forward that existed for only an hour OOPS). Next week, we're going to be launching a public beta branch on Steam, so the bravest among you can get the newest less-stable changes early and we can locate any glaring issues we might have missed.

It's been said a million times, but again THANK YOU SO MUCH for all of your patience, all of your excitement, all of your passion and love for the game. It's only gonna get even better from here!!!

Codspeed <3

- Aggro Crab

[h2]A few pieces of BIG NEWS this patch! [/h2]

:GoOver: We've located the memory leak in our level loading that was causing lag & crashes after many repeated deaths or scene transitions - this is potentially MASSIVE for performance and was likely the cause of several other mysterious issues as the game's memory use stacked up.

This patch also includes some balance changes to builds relying on high ATK + Scrap Hammer. It's a single-player game, and ultimately we're not going to get too picky about how powerful certain builds are, but we felt that some stuff was pretty far off where we wanted. We've nerfed Shark Tooth, as it essentially felt like a must-pick for any ATK-based build. But simultaneously, we've made Lug Nut slightly better, and MASSIVELY buffed the Dispatch skill, in the hopes that capsizing enemies continues to feel worth it into the late-game. notes.title: Responding to your Demo Feedback!
notes.content:
As part of the thankful season, we're thankful for all of the feedback, bug reports and support for Another Crab's Treasure you guys have given us! It's been one month since we took the demo down, and we've been using this time to implement a variety of changes for the final game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/8bc7f0776766e1479e79ee74bc0c1c2279a812d4.png[/img]

Why did we take the demo down, you ask? Firstly, with all these big changes we made in the last month, we didn't want an old stinky version of the game out in the wild. On top of that, while it's been an incredible opportunity to hear your thoughts and feedback, it can be quite mentally taxing for the team!! Keeping on top of your comments while in the final stretch of development is [i]a lot[/i], so you'll just have to trust us that this is for the best.

That being said, the feedback came to good use. Here's some updates that we've made within the past month. And there's more to come!

[h2]COMBAT[/h2]

The main gist of your combat complaints was that it felt a bit slippery or unpredictable. 
[list]
[*]Kril now has a new 4-hit-combo. It's a little slower because we want to encourage methodical play instead of players just button mashing (it's me, I'm Players). 
[*]Attacks now have more of a rhythm to them to make it more predictable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/bacc760223d4d68b153885c395e4b529b1d81316.gif[/img]

[*]It is also now smoother to combo these attacks into one of your adaptations or shell spells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/e2ef6baf7bc6b704365221004af2e77655954e6e.gif[/img]

[*] Players were getting stuck in their attack animation quite a lot - so we made it easier to escape with a block or a dodge. 
[*] You can now dodge roll in mid-air (or, mid float I guess).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/dec7a3d0a8f3fceaf2c77317a692a72810ac9e78.gif[/img]

[*]Lunging during attacks no longer feels slippery. When you attack now you don't fly and get sent as far forward. Each attack lets you come to a complete stop.

[*]There's now a visual poise meter. When the bar is charged, hit them with a strong attack so you can literally kick ‘em while they're down. 
[/list]

These changes are so you, the player, can have more expression in combat—so you can do what you intend to do, when you want to. If you would like to hear a full video explaining it, we made some TikToks about the changes ([url=https://www.tiktok.com/@aggrocrabgames/video/7301418661879893279?lang=en]PART 1[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@aggrocrabgames/video/7304002474053029150?lang=en]PART 2[/url])


[h2]SHELLS[/h2]

Shell stat balancing has been tough since we don't want players ONLY dodging and never blocking. Both have to FEEL good though!

[list]
[*]Heavy Shell health has been dramatically nerfed.
[*] Dodging sucks less (we've made it smoother for the player to use during combat and in general).
[*]Some players really wanted to hold on to their beloved shells. There's a new ability in our skill tree that lets you regain shell health by attacking enemies and it feels a lot better. You only have a short window of time to regain it, so be aggro!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375509/48d20dfcd07dccf8584d6a49b425396360615335.gif[/img]

[h2]PLATFORMING[/h2]

A lot of you are raving about the platforming, to the point where there's demand for more! Admittedly, we've put more focus into depth in our combat system but we can confirm that there's plenty of platforming in the mix! It's more for vibes than a core skill for you to master. 

Some folks have said the platforming is slippery, we're still working on improving that so it should be in a better place by launch!

[h2]ACCESSIBILITY[/h2]

[list]
[*]Controller remapping - we're continuing to refine our controller remapping to allow more accessibility to players, but we've also added an option to use a separate button for sprint. 
[/list]

This is just a (crab) pinch of all the new changes! It's been a busy year for Aggro Crab. We're sleepy, we're excited. Keep an eye out for our last dev log of the year, rounding up everything we achieved with Another Crab's Treasure.

- Paige (Community Manager)
